title: "Chris F"
---

Your exploratory data analysis of the team datasets go here.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DataExplorer)

soccer <- read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2023/2023-04-04/soccer21-22.csv')
```
Creates an HTML report of basic statistics, data structure, univariate plots, and correlation analyses.
```{r}
create_report(soccer)
```

Does the same in relation to the Home Team variable.
```{r}
create_report(soccer, y = "HomeTeam")
```

Does the same in relation to the Away Team variable.
```{r}
create_report(soccer, y = "AwayTeam")
```

Does the same in relation to Full Time Home Goals.
```{r}
create_report(soccer, y = "FTHG")
```

Does the same in relation to Full Time Away Goals.
```{r}
create_report(soccer, y = "FTAG")
```
